description.narrative: AfricInvest Fund IV is a generalist pan-African fund aiming to foster the growth of African enterprises across the continent. It will invest in mid-cap and growth-oriented companies in sectors including financial services, agribusiness, logistics, manufacturing, healthcare, and education.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: We invested in the fund alongside Finnfund, the Finnish development finance institution, strengthening our long-standing relationships with AfricInvest and anchoring the fund’s first close at $202 million. The commitments were made at a particularly challenging time given the context of COVID and will enable AfricInvest to invest in promising, growth-oriented companies, creating up to 2,500 jobs across the continent.
